summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Vision Board bilingual gallery. All 3 backend API tests pass (templates=5 with required fields, favorites toggle add/remove, favorites GET persistence). All frontend flows verified end-to-end: header (brand, favorites counter, language toggle FR/EN, theme toggle light/dark) all render and function; 5 gallery cards render with correct data-testids; filter tabs correctly filter (holistic->only pillars visible, artistic->only sensory visible); language toggle switches ALL visible text (hero H1, filter labels, section title); theme toggle adds/removes 'dark' class on <html>; favorites toggle updates counter, shows sonner toast (add + remove), persists across page reload via vb_session localStorage id; favorites right-side panel opens with correct content and empty-state absent; each of the 5 template cards opens the full-screen detail view with the template-specific structure block (interactive-wheel-pillars, roadmap-timeline-container, identity-manifesto-container, sensory-moodboard-grid, cockpit-dashboard-grid) and detail-close-button dismisses the overlay returning to gallery. No console errors observed.

issues: Card title text of stacked hero preview cards overlaps/clips at some viewports (e.g. 'Les Piliers d' and 'La Feuille d' are truncated by adjacent stacked cards). Decorative only, but readability could be improved.
Escape key does not close the favorites side panel; only the explicit close (X) button dismisses it. Consider adding ESC + backdrop-click to close for standard UX.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Support Escape key and backdrop-click to close FavoritesPanel.
(Optional/minor) Adjust stacked hero preview cards so template names are not clipped by adjacent cards at desktop widths.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: Endpoints are clean, use Pydantic models, no _id leakage, upsert used for favorites. Consider a small validation that template_id is one of the known TEMPLATES ids to prevent storing arbitrary strings.
server.py: CORS middleware is added AFTER include_router; still works with FastAPI but idiomatic to add middleware before route include.

Frontend: TemplateCard wraps the entire card in a <button>, and the favorite <button> is nested inside that button (invalid HTML: button-in-button). It works due to stopPropagation, but nested interactive elements can cause a11y/hydration warnings. Consider using a <div role=button> or moving the fav button outside the outer button.
seed_data_creation: None. Backend test uses unique TEST_ prefixed session_ids per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 3 tests, all passing). Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend flows already validated: language toggle text button reads 'FR'/'EN', favorites counter badge text becomes 'Favoris{n}' (label + count). LocalStorage key for session is 'vb_session'.
